en: This is a vintage postcard depicting a large, classical European building with a clock tower and a domed cupola. In front of the building, there is a statue within a fenced square and several small trees. The main building has symmetrical windows with flower boxes. The surrounding area includes smaller houses and a few people. The text at the top is in German and reads 'Hainichen i. Sa. Rathaus mit Gellertdenkmal.'
